sentiment.instructions: Read the text and decide which sentiment it expresses overall. Consider the text as a whole rather than individual words, and take irony, sarcasm and negation into account.

criteria.positive: The text as a whole conveys approval, praise, satisfaction, enthusiasm, gratitude, affection or another favorable stance. A text that mentions some drawbacks still counts as positive if the favorable stance clearly dominates.
criteria.neutral: The text conveys no clear sentiment. This includes purely factual statements, questions, announcements and texts whose positive and negative parts roughly balance each other.
criteria.negative: The text as a whole conveys criticism, complaint, anger, sadness, fear, disgust, disappointment or another unfavorable stance. A text that mentions some good points still counts as negative if the unfavorable stance clearly dominates.
